text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I happened upon King Halo and Fuji Kiseki
talking in the hallway.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gathering together to dance...
How utterly marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you're interested, my little pony,
would you care to dance with us?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
May I really?!
In that case, by all means...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, let's have a wonderful time on the day!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You over there, too.
Feel free to come along if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The invitation is already right there in your hands...
Voila!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking down at my hand when told, before I even realized it,
I was holding an invitation to a mysterious ball...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, were you invited to the ball as well?
How fortunate for you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
After all, you will be blessed to witness the dance
of this King, the flower of high society, in person!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Such supreme happiness is truly rare!
Wouldn't you agree?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah... people are bound to whisper among themselves.
'Who is that lady standing over there? Could that be—'

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Do not make it a question!
State it clearly: 'King!'

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
At this ball, my dance with Fuji-senpai
shall keep every pair of eyes in the hall glued on me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...However, if I am to stand alongside Fuji-senpai,
my preparations must also be nothing less than first-rate.
choice_data_list: Sounds like a lot of work.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This isn't someone else's problem, it's yours too!
Since you were invited, you must strive for your absolute best!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
First, a total reform of our mindset. Where should we begin?
Give me your advice.
choice_data_list: Special dance training to steal the spotlight

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I see?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, as the flower of the ball, it is only natural
to monopolize every gaze in the venue through dance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Flawlessly carrying the outfit while flitting about
as lightly as a butterfly—that is true first-rate... You understand well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's decided, let special training begin!
Keep your eyes wide open and watch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*SPLAAASH!!*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I-It's so cooold!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: King Halo's resolve was certainly not half-baked—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pouring buckets of water over layers of clothes
to dance under heavy extra weight...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She frequently visited amusement parks,
mentally training by studying parade dancers.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A posture and smile that never waver even in heavy attire...
This is where I aim to be. No, even higher than this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Carrying on in this fashion, several days passed—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
How about this, my splendid footwork!
The name of first-rate isn't just for show, you know!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hem of her racing attire fluttering like the wings of a dancing butterfly...
She had attained her ideal movement.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate attire... Yes,
to be first-rate means to master the absolute pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I shall depart on a journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Project King—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
King Halo's mornings start early.
She flips through numerous books,
referencing dress patterns.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Classical yet eye-catching...
If that is the case, yes... this is it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The word 'compromise' does not exist in 'first-rate'.
In search of a legendary fabric artisan, she challenged steep mountain trails.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why... on earth... would anyone choose
to live in a place like this...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*Cough*!
The dust is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the ocean on a chartered boat,
she sought a renowned tailor.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really here?!
Do people actually live here?!

text_block_list.name: Sailor
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
It's a joke!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You can't be serious?!
No thank you to jokes! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming countless hardships, she made her return.
All for the sake of obtaining this one consummate outfit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
How does it look? I had my racewear tailored
into a flawless, immaculate masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho!
Ohohohoho!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the outfit perfected down to the finest detail,
it felt boorish to ask how it differed from her usual one.
—Her arduous efforts had borne fruit.
